mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.username AS user_name, o.address_id, o.status, o.total_amount, o.pay_method, o.pay_time, o.accept_time, o.finish_time, o.cancel_time, o.cancel_by, o.cancel_reason, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.delivery_address, o.remark, o.create_time, o.update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, address_id, status, total_amount, pay_method, pay_time, accept_time, finish_time, cancel_time, cancel_by, cancel_reason, receiver_name, receiver_phone, delivery_address, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{addressId}, #{status}, #{totalAmount}, #{payMethod}, #{payTime}, #{acceptTime}, #{finishTime}, #{cancelTime}, #{cancelBy}, #{cancelReason}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{deliveryAddress}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM orders o JOIN `user` u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, address_id, status, total_amount, pay_method, pay_time, accept_time, finish_time, cancel_time, cancel_by, cancel_reason, receiver_name, receiver_phone, delivery_address, remark, create_time, update_time FROM orders WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, address_id, status, total_amount, pay_method, pay_time, accept_time, finish_time, cancel_time, cancel_by, cancel_reason, receiver_name, receiver_phone, delivery_address, remark, create_time, update_time FROM orders WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 1, pay_method = 1, pay_time = #{time} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
UPDATE orders SET status = 4, cancel_time = #{time}, cancel_by = 1, cancel_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
UPDATE orders SET status = 3, finish_time = #{time} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 2
UPDATE orders SET status = 2, accept_time = #{time} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE orders SET status = 4, cancel_time = #{time}, cancel_by = 2, cancel_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (1, 2)
